newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq to close for Martin Luther King day in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq to close for Martin Luther King day in 1998.

text.p: Nasdaq stock market will close in honor of Martin Luther King Jr.'s birthday beginning January 19, 1998, the National Association of Securities Dealers said Thursday.
The move comes in conjunction with the New York Stock Exchange which earlier announced its decision to close on the holiday which is marked on the third Monday of January.
Previously, Nasdaq had observed the civil rights leader's birthday with a voluntary minute-long trading halt, NASD said in a statement.
